lang.engine.link.example.cmt.parse: Extract and validate the JSON the model returned
lang.engine.link.example.cmt.align: Return a translations array aligned with targetLangs

lang.engine.link.example.cmt.apiKey: Fill in your API key here

lang.engine.link.example.cmt.plain: No JSON envelope — the translation comes back as-is, and the wrapper's tokens are never generated
lang.engine.link.example.cmt.clean: Cheap insurance: strip surrounding quotes, nothing more
lang.engine.link.example.cmt.timeout: Fail fast: the SDK defaults to a 600s read timeout and 2 retries. A late subtitle is worse than a missing one
lang.engine.link.example.cmt.timeoutUnit: This timeout is in milliseconds (the OpenAI one is in seconds)
lang.engine.link.example.cmt.perLangFail: One language failing must not take the others down: leave just that line empty

color.title: Color palette
style.overflow.deprecated: Not recommended: long translations can display incorrectly.
blacklist.hint: Listed words are replaced with the same number of asterisks as characters. Applied to both source and translation.
blacklist.useDefaults.desc: Masks explicit Japanese words from a built-in list. The list is never shown on screen. English profanity is already masked by speech recognition.
obs.status.failed.unreachable: Connection failed: can't reach the server (make sure OBS's WebSocket server is enabled and the URL/port are correct)
obs.status.hint.checkPort: Can't connect? OBS may have changed the port. Check Tools → WebSocket Server Settings and update the URL above.
obs.drag.all.tip: Drag to OBS source list to create the full subtitle source
obs.drag.source.tip: Drag to OBS source list to create the source subtitle
obs.drag.target1.tip: Drag to OBS source list to create the translation-1 subtitle
obs.drag.target2.tip: Drag to OBS source list to create the translation-2 subtitle
obs.autoSetup.hint: Auto-creates 4 subtitle sources in the current scene (requires a WebSocket connection).
obs.help.title: How to use
obs.help.step2: Check the URL and password, then turn on WebSocket connection.
obs.help.step3: Click OBS Auto Setup, or drag a link above into the OBS source list.
obs.help.step4: Press Start in this tool to sync subtitles to OBS.
obs.help.note: Choose one source creation method: Auto Setup or manual drag-and-drop.
obs.mode.ws.desc: Sends subtitles straight to OBS browser sources. Fully transparent, and each line is its own source you can place separately. Requires OBS’s WebSocket server.
obs.mode.capture.desc: Capture this window in OBS and key out the background color. No WebSocket setup is required, but the subtitles are captured as a single image rather than separate sources.
obs.capture.bg.hint: The color the chroma key removes. Avoid a color your game uses a lot.
obs.capture.step1: Add a Window Capture source in OBS and pick this browser window.
obs.capture.step2: Add a Chroma Key filter to that source and set its color to match the background.
obs.capture.step3: When that is ready, use the button below to enter capture mode.
obs.capture.enter.hint: Collapses the control panel so only the subtitles show. Click the background to bring it back — the toolbar’s lock button freezes that click while you stream.
obs.capture.note1: Don’t give a subtitle the same color as the background — the text gets keyed out with it.
obs.capture.note2: Don’t minimize the browser window; window capture stops updating.
obs.capture.note3: If a fringe of color remains, raise the chroma key’s Similarity.
obs.capture.note4: Browser zoom is separate from subtitle text size. Adjust the size in the subtitle settings.

settings.clearIdle.title: Auto-clear subtitles
settings.clearIdle.desc: Clears all subtitle lines if no new speech is recognized for the selected time after a sentence is finalized. Subtitles are also cleared when you stop recognition.
settings.browserAI.title: Browser AI translation
settings.browserAI.desc: Not recommended: translates with Chrome’s Prompt API (Gemini Nano). It costs about 0.8s per line and its output is unreliable outside its supported languages (en / ja / es / de / fr). The model stays in memory while selected. Turning this on adds it to the engine picker.
